name: My Home Tridasa
usps: Ideally located in Tellapur, offering excellent connectivity via the Outer Ring Road (ORR) to major commercial hubs like HITEC City, Financial District, and Gachibowli.
Offers 84% open spaces, featuring beautifully crafted landscaping, an olive meadow, and a central park.
Features a generous 100 ft distance between the towers to ensure maximum privacy and ventilation.
Equipped with a comprehensive automated billing system for water, power, gas, and maintenance.
amenities: Swimming pool, outdoor gym, badminton court, squash court, and tennis court.
Pharmacy & Health Centre, Crèche, Spa & Salon, and Grocery Store.
Multi-purpose halls, guest rooms, library/reading room, and ATM.
target_audience: IT professionals and modern families seeking a premium, highly amenitized, lushly landscaped high-rise township close to Hyderabad's Financial District.
